notes: All performance numbers include the fixed telemetry collector; baseline sample wall time is about 79 ms median per 250 ms interval. Uninstrumented speed is unmeasured.
Headroom minima are sampled at 250 ms nominal intervals, not continuous transient guarantees.
System MemAvailable measures whole-board headroom; do not add driver allocations to overlapping RSS/PSS.
500 MB reserve is 500000000 bytes, approximately 476.84 MiB.
System paging counters bracket intervals with 250 ms samples; they cannot identify the responsible process.
Process-cold startups retain uncontrolled existing operating-system caches; no board restart or cache clearing.
Gemma idle prefill is a no-op; product turn latency includes conversation setup and inference.

Qwen/CUDA retains current pause/resume; CPU arms use six intra-op and one inter-op thread with uninterrupted generation. The control compares the complete CPU speech policy, including removal of the pause, not provider placement alone.
Same 672-pixel JPEG input; Qwen image cap 256, LiteRT native adapters 70/140/280 with no exact 256-token control.
Native decode probes use 128 output tokens and no speech; product turns use 64 and one sentence.
Qwen stream=false decode probes do not measure first-token latency; product replay does.
Native LLM-overlap detection is available for Gemma only; synthesis and paced playback are measured for all arms.
CPU component exercise up to 39 words exceeds product 18-word phrase cap and remains diagnostic.
47 questions span 21 recorded sessions, with existing resets; 120 oracle stress questions are one session without internal resets.
Recurring stress repeats the same green statement; 20/20 evidence matches cannot prove unique occurrence provenance.
Recorded line_s, asr_s, first_token_s, first_phrase_s, first_audio_s, and answer_done_s are cumulative from speech end; retrieval_s is a stage duration. Oracle latency starts at submitted text.
A split fixture stores its last subturn latency and scores joint correctness as failed; generated reply completion precedes paced playback drain.
File fixtures replace live camera input, and browser preview remains paused; model-pipeline residency is complete, live device/preview overhead remains unqualified.
WAV first-audio time is synthesis readiness, and the sink is paced by audio duration; physical audible latency remains unmeasured.
Speech matching uses WER against generated text, not a separate semantic judgment of the transcript.
Baseline early sysfs GPU-clock coverage is missing; its temperatures, CPU clocks, and all memory samples are present.
One Qwen infrastructure interruption precedes any replay answers; its receipt is preserved separately.
No quality failure is retried, no production stores/releases change, and no held-out/M2-M3/eight-hour adoption claim is made.
